International transfer

ANZ International Money Transfer

If you're sending money overseas, an ANZ International Money Transfer offers you convenience, speed and peace of mind.

Convenient and secure IMTs with ANZ

Convenience

You can send an IMT anytime, anywhere using ANZ goMoney and Internet Banking—, making it one of the most convenient ways to send money overseas.

Competitive fees

Pay no ANZ transfer fee for IMTs made using goMoney and Internet Banking. Even better, we’ll cover the standard overseas bank fees for transfers to Australia, the UK, US, India, and 10 Pacific countries.

Peace of mind

Your funds will be sent through the worldwide bank network and you’ll also be protected by OnlineCode – our two-factor authentication service that provides a second layer of security.

OUR Fee

An OUR Fee may apply to your payment.

  • The OUR Fee is a process fee charged by ANZ. In turn, ANZ will cover fees charged by our correspondent banks used in processing your payments and these are settled directly with ANZ. If you are using goMoney or Internet Banking, you’ll see how much the OUR Fee is before you make the payment. Other banks (including other intermediary banks and/or the payee's bank) may charge additional fees or deduct fees from the amount transferred. These fees vary depending on the currency and bank you are sending the payment to and are outside of our control.
  • ANZ charges an OUR Fee for international payments which may not represent the actual costs incurred, including those imposed by intermediary banks. As a result, ANZ may incur a loss or gain on individual transactions as part of our pricing policy.
  • An OUR Fee applies when you make an international money transfer in:
    • Foreign currency to any other account (including ANZ accounts) in New Zealand or another country; or
    • NZD to an account in another country. In goMoney or Internet Banking NZD can only be sent to the Cook Islands.
  • For some currencies, you can choose to either:
    • Pay the OUR Fee to ANZ from one of your accounts to provide more certainty on the full payment value being delivered to the recipient; or
    • Have the other banks (including intermediary banks and/or the payee's bank) deduct any fees or charges before the proceeds are paid to the beneficiary.

We cover the OUR Fee for sending money via goMoney or Internet Banking in:

  • AUD to Australia
  • GBP to the United Kingdom
  • USD to the United States
  • INR to India
  • FJD to Fiji
  • SBD to Solomon Islands
  • WST to Samoa
  • TOP to Tonga
  • VUV to Vanuatu
  • NZD to Cook Islands
  • PGK to Papua New Guinea
  • AUD to Kiribati
  • XPF to New Caledonia
  • USD to Timor Leste

Sending money overseas

How to send an IMT

For more detailed instructions, see Send an international money transfer.

ANZ goMoney app

In goMoney, go to Payments > Overseas Payments.

If you don’t have goMoney yet, you can download it now. Eligibility criteria and terms and conditions apply, see important information below.

Download on the App Store (for iOS)
Download on Google Play (for Android™)

ANZ Internet Banking

In Internet Banking, go to Pay & transfer > Send money overseas.

Log in to Internet Banking

Call or visit us

$0 ANZ transfer fee offers don’t apply to transfers made by phone or in branch.

  • Call us on 0800 269 296 (or +64 4 470 3142 if you’re overseas) and select option 0 for personal assistance
  • Bring a completed International money transfer application form (PDF 147KB) and your photo ID to any ANZ branch.

ANZ Direct Online (business customers)

$0 ANZ transfer fee offers don’t apply to transfers made using Direct Online.

Log in to Direct Online
